podcast.body: A track by Age of Electric from their 1997 album *Make a Pest a Pet*, featured on *Big Shiny Tunes 3*. "Age of Electric with remote control from their 1997 album Give a Pesta Pet, and a track on the third edition of Big Shiny Toons."
